operation_details.item: The user's Channel 1 receives 40% of the media budget.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How is the campaign planning coming along today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good so far. I’m reviewing the media mix and making sure the allocations still support the broader brand strategy.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What does the current split look like?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Channel 1 receives 40% of the media budget, Channel 2 receives 30%, and Channel 3 receives 20%.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That leaves 10% unassigned. Is the allocation reviewed on a regular cycle?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the budget allocation is reviewed quarterly. The remaining amount can be handled separately depending on the campaign needs.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Are you focusing next on campaign messaging or customer engagement?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Customer engagement is next. I want to make sure the channel plan supports the campaign goals without relying on the usual marketing assumptions.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the 40% allocation for Channel 1, while keeping the allocations for Channels 2 and 3 and the review cycle.
